ARCFLUX - credits and provenance

- All GDScript code and shaders in this pack were written specifically for ARCFLUX,
  with the help of an AI coding assistant. Nothing was copied from godotshaders.com,
  GitHub, other asset packs or tutorials. Techniques are standard, first-principles
  graphics methods: midpoint displacement for lightning paths, value noise and fBm,
  camera-facing ribbon expansion in the vertex shader, analytic radial falloffs.
- No textures or images are used by the effects. The only generated resource is a radial
  gradient for the optional PointLight2D, built at runtime with GradientTexture2D.
- No AI-generated images, audio or third-party art are included.
- Editor icons (addons/arcflux_fx/icons/*.svg) were drawn as hand-written SVG code.
- Demo fonts: Godot's built-in default font.
- Made with Godot Engine (MIT license, https://godotengine.org/license). Godot is not
  included in this pack.
